test_title: PYST 52: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 05 Nov, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
U, V, W, X, Y, Z and A are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order).

Only one person sits between Y and X when counted from the left of X. A sits third to the right of U. V sits third to the left of W. A sits to the immediate right of Z. Z is not an immediate neighbour of V.

How many people sit between Z and X when counted from the right of Z?
solution:
Given:

U, V, W, X, Y, Z and A are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

A sits third to the right of U. A sits to the immediate right of Z.

Only one person sits between Y and X when counted from the left of X.

V sits third to the left of W.
